definitions.explanation: A piece of land on which a building stands or is planned to be built.

examples.japanese: ⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧{敷地|しきち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{建|た}てた→建てる：01189_tateru⟧。
examples.english: We built a house on a large plot of land.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{敷地内|しきちない}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{禁煙|きんえん}→禁煙：02644_kinen⟧です。
examples.english: Smoking is prohibited on school grounds.

examples.japanese: {敷地|しきち}⟦{面積|めんせき}→面積：05330_menseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧500⟦{平方|へいほう}メートル→平方メートル：03148_heihoumeetoru⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The site area is approximately 500 square meters.

notes:
{敷地|しきち} refers to a plot of land, especially one where a building is or will be located.

Common collocations:
- {敷地|しきち}⟦{面積|めんせき}→面積：05330_menseki⟧ (site area)
- {敷地内|しきちない} (on the premises, within the grounds)
- {敷地|しきち}⟦{境界|きょうかい}→境界：12096_kyoukai⟧ (property boundary)
- ⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧{敷地|しきち} (spacious grounds)

Related words:
- ⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧ (land - general term)
- ⟦{用地|ようち}→用地：04088_youchi⟧ (site for a specific purpose)
- ⟦{宅地|たくち}→宅地：21589_takuchi⟧ (residential land)
